init.title: NFC Story Box settings
init.description: Changes apply as soon as you save. Cards, history and statistics are kept.

speaker.name: Speaker and reader
speaker.description: Where the cards play and which parts of the box are used.

data.phone_scan: Also play cards scanned with a phone

data_description.player: Cards play here. Only Music Assistant players are listed.
data_description.only_speaker: If this speaker is part of a Music Assistant group that is on, Music Assistant plays on the whole group. Turn this on to switch that group off first, so only this speaker plays.
data_description.button_event: The box's buttons (previous, next, volume). Leave empty if it has none.
data_description.card_present: Tells the box when a card is lifted, so it can pause. Leave empty to never pause on lifting.
data_description.sound_service: The beep played on a card (e.g. esphome.nfc_reader_play_sound). Found automatically if empty.
data_description.phone_scan: Lets the Home Assistant app on a phone act as a second reader: holding a card to the phone plays it, just like on the box. Off means only the box's reader counts. Needs the app with NFC on the phone.

playback.name: Playing
playback.description: Volume and what happens when a card is lifted.

data.pause_on_remove: Pause when the card is lifted

data_description.start_volume: Volume a new card starts at. 0 leaves the speaker's volume as it is.
data_description.volume_step: How much the volume buttons change it each press.
data_description.pause_on_remove: Pauses when the card is taken off the reader.
data_description.resume_same_card: When the same card goes back on, it continues where it stopped instead of starting over.

limits.name: Quiet hours and limits
limits.description: Keep the box calm at night and limit listening time.

data.quiet_stories_only: Only story cards in quiet hours

data_description.quiet_start: Set both start and end, or leave both empty.
data_description.quiet_max_volume: Volume is held at or below this in quiet hours. 0 means no change.
data_description.quiet_stories_only: Music cards are not played in quiet hours; story cards are.
data_description.daily_limit: Minutes of listening per day. 0 means no limit.

stats.name: Statistics
stats.description: Listening statistics and the weekly summary.

data_description.record_stats: Keeps a log of what was played and when (90 days). It stays in Home Assistant.
data_description.summary_notify: Choose the phones or tablets that get the Sunday 18:00 summary. The list shows the notification actions that exist in Home Assistant; pick several to send to several devices. Leave empty for no message.

error.invalid_service: An action looks like domain.name, for example notify.mobile_app_phone.
error.unknown_notify: That notification action does not exist in Home Assistant.
error.quiet_incomplete: Quiet hours need both a start and an end.
error.quiet_same: Quiet hours start and end at the same time.

speaker_unavailable.title: NFC Story Box can't reach its speaker
speaker_unavailable.description: A card was put on the box, but the speaker `{speaker}` is missing or unavailable, so nothing played. Check that the speaker is switched on, or choose another Music Assistant player in the integration's settings.

no_music_assistant.title: NFC Story Box needs Music Assistant
no_music_assistant.description: The cards are played through Music Assistant, but that integration is not set up. Add the Music Assistant integration and then reload NFC Story Box.
